thresholds.borrowed_fit: fit_source == 'pooled': fewer than 5000 Suomi-NPP training detections (2012-2018); kappa also borrowed when fewer than 500 Aqua training detections
thresholds.insufficient_training_observations: n_train_aqua == 0 and n_train_viirs_frp_ge_100 == 0: no Aqua training target 2012-2018, and the threshold-baseline search (T up to 100 MW) then meets an empty cell-month table. No minimum above zero is coded
thresholds.no_observations: no Aqua and no Suomi-NPP detections at all in 2012-2021
thresholds.insufficient_reference_observations: n_modis_2009_2011 == 0 or n_any_2012_2014 == 0 (null-control window empty), or n_test_aqua == 0 (no held-out Aqua to validate against)
thresholds.insufficient_heldout_variation: n_test_aqua > 0 but concentrated in so few cells that a cell-bootstrap resample of the held-out cell-months has zero variance or zero total
thresholds.numerical_fit_failure: re-running fit_country did not fail where the counts predict, or the published error does not match the counts (none expected)
thresholds.verification: each failed country is re-run through fit_country; the failing line must match the status. insufficient_heldout_variation depends on bootstrap draws, so a re-run may not fail (reproduced_on_rerun false); the published error type is then the evidence

count_definitions.n_train_viirs_frp_ge_100: Suomi-NPP training detections with FRP >= 100 MW (largest baseline threshold)
count_definitions.n_train_cell_months / n_test_cell_months: H3 res-5 cell x month with any Aqua or Suomi-NPP detection
count_definitions.n_test_cell_months_with_aqua / n_test_ce: held-out cell-months with Aqua > 0; distinct res-5 cells
